en.ui.dim3.axes_note: Signed B minus A offsets use the stored world or owning-component axes, never the camera axes.
en.ui.dim3.freedom_note: Free axes show coordinate components that can still move, possibly together with other points. Viewport arrows show local allowed directions; these are not independent axis locks.
en.ui.dim3.help: Pick a line for its length, an arc for radius, or two points for distance. Choose Angle and pick two lines. Dimensions remain driving when geometry moves.
en.ui.dim3.title: 3D Dimensions
